operation_policy: Validate and retain every raw frame. Compare every actual Rust frame, including both base frames, with every actual candidate frame for the same operation. Redraw counts are not equated.
source_projection: Filter actual Rust paint-entry callbacks by authored box labels. Compare their observed order, bounds and full-viewport masks exactly with genuine core Quad command IDs/emission order, tree layout, and intersections of actual emitted clip stacks. No tree walk substitutes for emitted commands.
unmapped_structure: All actual Rust request/prepaint/paint entry and return wrapper callbacks remain retained raw. All actual core structural helper/attachment nodes remain retained separately. There is no corresponding per-node core callback API.
numerical_justification: Frozen authored coordinates and all physical edges are exactly integral for scales 1, 1.25 and 2. Approved actual Rust deviations are zero. No fitted tolerance or fractional logical rounding claim.
control_gate: Before each isolated one-site production control reopen successful source-bound ordinary and all four same-final-core regressions. Require successful build and runtime, valid exact session/input and structural trace, then all frozen semantic witnesses. Build/transport/validation failures are not kills.
